title: Quick Flaky Turkish Chuck Roast Pilaf
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring chuck roast, with an herbal flavor and a flaky texture, finished to an al-dente perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chuck roast cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the Turkish spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the skillet with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is al-dente.
While the pilaf is baking, prepare the flaky topping by mixing the beaten egg with a fork until it is frothy.
After the pilaf has baked for 25 minutes, remove it from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
Drizzle the egg mixture over the pilaf and use a fork to create a flaky texture on the surface.
